selection: First fixed16 source batch plus28 purposive contrasts after full778 native-event cohort reading; not prevalence or model effect.

records.reference: how often does the train arrive and depart from penn station
records.rationale: Arrival/departure occurrences are explicitly queried for their recurrence; not a command to operate the assistant.

records.reference: turn off smart socket
records.rationale: Turn off only specifies the current control operation; no event is separately represented as content.

records.reference: what shape is a ball
records.rationale: Shape of a ball is a static property, without an occurrence.

records.reference: how is my inbox looking at the moment
records.rationale: Current inbox appearance is a state query, with no separately represented event.

records.reference: show me the best podcast of folk songs having rating of above four star and play it
records.rationale: Show and play specify assistant operations; podcast and songs are content kinds, not represented performances or events.

records.reference: i would like to listen to my audiobook
records.rationale: Listen specifies playback; the audiobook is a work, not an event-content argument.

records.reference: is the celebrity single or married
records.rationale: Single or married is marital state here; no marriage ceremony or transition is described.

records.reference: set a reminder for tomorrow for meeting with allen
records.rationale: Meeting is explicit reminder content.

records.reference: what is the current temperature in miami
records.rationale: Current temperature is a scalar property, not a represented occurrence.

records.reference: is the sun gonna shine in devon this weekend
records.rationale: Sun shining in Devon this weekend is an explicitly queried bounded occurrence.

records.reference: remind me about my monday meeting with peter francis fifteen minutes before the meeting
records.rationale: Meeting is explicitly referenced as reminder content and temporal anchor.

records.reference: who assassinated lincoln
records.rationale: The assassination is an explicit past occurrence whose participant is queried.

records.reference: hey olly post my complaint to @microsoft on twitter
records.rationale: Posting is the assistant operation; complaint is message content without an expressed event description.

records.reference: check recent news on someone
records.rationale: News about someone supplies a subject but no expressed event to infer.

records.reference: weather this week
records.rationale: Weather for a period requests conditions without naming a particular occurrence.

records.reference: play country
records.rationale: Play is the assistant operation; country is a genre, not an event.

records.reference: olly alert me at three pm to go to the concert
records.rationale: Going to the concert is alert content.

records.reference: i'm in a meeting please do not speak
records.rationale: Being in a meeting motivates the no-speech request and is relevant event content.

records.reference: mike will send me an email tomorrow can you please set up an alarm fifteen minutes after receiving that email
records.rationale: Receiving the email is a condition/temporal anchor for the alarm.

records.reference: i need to set an alarm tomorrow at one thousand two hundred pm to remind me to take my medication
records.rationale: Taking medication is explicitly the reminder content.

records.reference: do i need to use sunscreen before going to meet my friend for lunch
records.rationale: Meeting a friend for lunch supplies the activity motivating sunscreen advice.

records.reference: should i wear winter boots when i go to the store
records.rationale: Going to the store supplies the activity constraining footwear advice.

records.reference: tell me later to file the invoice
records.rationale: Filing the invoice is the future reminder content.

records.reference: delete all events from calendar
records.rationale: All events explicitly identifies an event set for deletion; no unique event title required.

records.reference: please send a mail to mr richard stating that i going to met him on first of february twenty seventeen at five pm at this office
records.rationale: Meeting the recipient is explicit requested mail content.

records.reference: please remind me to take off coffee off stove in ten minutes
records.rationale: Taking coffee off the stove is the reminder content, even though direct stove control alone would not suffice.

records.reference: remind me to turn off the lights in ten minutes
records.rationale: Turning off lights is explicit reminder content.

records.reference: i am no longer going to wyatts birthday party
records.rationale: The birthday party remains expressed despite negated attendance.

records.reference: what meetings did i have last week
records.rationale: Past meetings are explicitly queried.

records.reference: add to calendar dr k at three hundred and thirty pm on march seven
records.rationale: Doctor name and time in a calendar command suggest an appointment, but no event expression establishes the role without inferring an omitted argument.

records.reference: i no longer need to see the doctor can that event be removed
records.rationale: Seeing the doctor is the canceled activity and referred to as that event.

records.reference: can you add name location to calendar
records.rationale: Name location is a malformed placeholder; no established event content.

records.reference: add new event named anna to calendar
records.rationale: New event named Anna explicitly assigns the label to an event; no person role inferred solely from the name.

records.reference: create an empty calendar event for next saturday at ten am
records.rationale: Empty calendar event explicitly names an event category even though details are unspecified.

records.reference: what is the best chili there is
records.rationale: Best chili is a food-quality query without a represented event; native positivity does not decide the semantic role.

records.reference: clear my events search data
records.rationale: Events is explicit subject matter of the search data to clear, not inferred from the clear operation.

records.reference: recommend a movie which is released last friday
records.rationale: Release last Friday describes a past event constraining movie selection.

records.reference: what are the show times for logan at the nearby theatre
records.rationale: Show times refers explicitly to scheduled screenings, not merely the film title.

records.reference: are there any accidents today
records.rationale: Accidents today explicitly queries occurrences.

records.reference: schedule me a taxi for after my thursday meeting
records.rationale: Thursday meeting is the temporal anchor of taxi scheduling.

records.reference: i would want you to tweet for me at india consumer complaints forum regarding the late delivery of gas cylinder
records.rationale: Late delivery is the event described in requested complaint content.

records.reference: did anyone get engaged or give birth among my online friends
records.rationale: Getting engaged and giving birth are explicitly queried occurrences.

records.reference: reply to john stating that i will attend the party
records.rationale: Attending the party is requested reply content.

records.reference: send a birthday email to my boss
records.rationale: Birthday supplies an occasion constraining the requested message.

admission: Same-agent reference proposals; no waveform listening or independent semantic certification.
